description:
Create a 3D solid model of a Clevis Rod End (Fork Joint) in FreeCAD based on the DIN 71752 standard. 

Specifications:
1. Shank: Cylinder, Diameter 18mm, Length 20mm. Aligned along negative X-axis (from X=-20 to X=0).
2. Fork Head: Block, 20mm (Length X) x 30mm (Width Y) x 30mm (Height Z). Starts at X=0 and extends to X=20.
3. Slot: A 12mm wide gap centered on the Y-axis (removing material between Y=-6 and Y=6) cut into the Fork Head, creating two arms.
4. Pin Hole: A 10mm diameter through-hole passing through both arms of the fork. The hole axis should be parallel to the Y-axis and located at X=10, Z=0.

Save the completed model to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/clevis_rod_end.FCStd'. Ensure the result is a single valid solid object.
